entities.name: Muzzio
entities.description: A brilliant inventor and professor at the Academy at High Paliano whose constructs spy on the city and who manipulates the board to gain the vice chancellorship.

entities.name: Irie
entities.description: A young Low City apprentice of Muzzio who keeps his workshop and secretly knows of his hidden passage.

entities.name: Chancellor Grinaldi
entities.description: The chancellor of the Academy who is forced to resign after Muzzio's construct exposes his affair.

entities.name: Professor Tulando
entities.description: An ancient professor elected future vice chancellor who resigns after being framed for embezzlement.

entities.name: Professor Emralla
entities.description: A professor whose money and estate vanish from the records after Muzzio's constructs alter them.

entities.name: Vice Chancellor Alendis
entities.description: The vice chancellor of the Academy who is soon to retire.

entities.name: Professor Fimarell
entities.description: A professor on the Academy's Board of Senior Advisors.

entities.name: Professor Regness
entities.description: A professor who was on sabbatical and later attends the board.

entities.name: Daretti
entities.description: A person Muzzio is rumored to have killed.

entities.name: Sydri
entities.description: A dropout of the Academy whose patron Muzzio is rumored to be.

entities.name: Ervos Trax
entities.description: A smuggler whose name appears in forged documents framing Tulando.

entities.name: Brago
entities.description: The king whose death and seeming ascension made the board vote more cautiously.

entities.name: The Black Rose
entities.description: A figure Muzzio is rumored to be an agent of.

entities.name: Academy at High Paliano
entities.description: The academy of Paliano governed by a Board of Senior Advisors.

entities.name: Paliano
entities.description: The city of High and Low halves whose scale model Muzzio keeps in his hidden workshop.

entities.name: Muzzio's Constructs
entities.description: Mechanical constructs designed by Muzzio that serve as clerks and secretly record conversations onto wax cylinders.

events.summary: The Board of Senior Advisors rejects Muzzio's motion to become vice chancellor after Alendis retires and elects Tulando instead.
events.quote: To elect Professor Tulando vice chancellor once Alendis retires.

events.summary: Tulando and Grinaldi discuss rumors that Muzzio serves the Black Rose, sponsors Sydri and killed Daretti.
Muzzio, upset at losing the vice chancellor vote, summons his apprentice Irie to his workshop to accelerate his training.
events.quote: he had summoned for his apprentice, Irie.

events.summary: Muzzio reveals his hidden workshop containing an army of constructs and a scale model of Paliano, and Irie pretends to see it for the first time.
events.quote: The centerpiece of the room, surrounded by whirring noises of various machines and the iron army, was a scale model of Paliano

events.summary: Muzzio denies ever having killed anyone and reveals that his constructs record everything people say onto wax cylinders.
events.quote: Within each of the constructs is a series of needles that transcribes all that they hear onto wax cylinders

events.summary: Muzzio explains his grand design to mitigate human variables and says the vice chancellorship would have given him the autonomy for the next phase; Brago's death and seeming ascension made the board cautious.
events.quote: But the death of Brago and his seeming ascension, which I couldn't foresee, caused them to vote more cautiously.

events.summary: Muzzio's constructs erase Professor Emralla's money and registration of her estate, leaving her facing eviction.
events.quote: Professor Emralla found that the bank no longer had record of her money.

events.summary: Tulando finds forged papers framing him for embezzlement and dealings with Ervos Trax on his breakfast table, and resigns within the hour.
events.quote: He resigned less than an hour later.

events.summary: A construct records Chancellor Grinaldi's affair and an envelope exposing it is left for his wife, forcing him to leave his position.
events.quote: The chancellor was forced to leave his position to fix his personal life.

events.summary: With the others gone, the board carries Muzzio's motion to become vice chancellor once Alendis becomes chancellor.

relations.note: Irie is Muzzio's apprentice and keeps up his workshop.
relations.quote: Muzzio had seen the potential in the boy and brought him on as his apprentice.

relations.note: Muzzio gives Irie lessons in exchange for his work.
relations.quote: Irie kept up Muzzio's workshop in exchange for the same lessons others spent family fortunes to obtain

relations.note: Every construct in Paliano is built with or from his designs.
relations.quote: Every construct in Paliano is either built with my designs or from my designs.

relations.note: Muzzio's constructs frame Tulando and force him to resign.
relations.quote: Tulando was innocent of all these crimes, but the message was clear.

relations.note: Muzzio's construct exposes Grinaldi's affair and forces him out.
relations.quote: He was having an affair, and a construct recorded this information.

relations.note: Tulando sits on the Academy's board.
relations.quote: Members present: Chancellor Grinaldi Vice Chancellor Alendis Professor Emralla Professor Fimarell Professor Muzzio Professor Tulando
